name: Update LeetCode Statistics

on:
  schedule:
    # Twice a day: LeetCode blocks runner IPs intermittently, so a second
    # attempt costs nothing and usually catches what the first one missed.
    - cron: "15 0 * * *"
    - cron: "15 12 * * *"

  workflow_dispatch:

  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/leetcode-stats.yml"
      - "scripts/update_leetcode.py"

permissions:
  contents: write

# Never let two runs push to main at the same time.
concurrency:
  group: leetcode-stats
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update-leetcode:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      # --fail-hard makes a failed refresh turn the run red instead of quietly
      # re-committing a stale snapshot and reporting success.
      - name: Generate LeetCode profile cards
        id: generate
        run: python3 scripts/update_leetcode.py --fail-hard

      # Runs even when the refresh failed: the cards are still re-rendered from
      # the last good snapshot, so the README never breaks.
      - name: Commit generated LeetCode assets
        if: always()
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add profile/leetcode-data.json \
                  profile/leetcode-overview.svg \
                  profile/leetcode-skills.svg \
                  README.md

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No LeetCode changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore: update LeetCode statistics"

          # The profile-stats workflow also pushes to main; rebase and retry so a
          # race never loses the update to a rejected push.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            git pull --rebase --autostash origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" && \
              git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" && exit 0
            echo "Push attempt ${attempt} failed; retrying..."
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "::error::Could not push updated LeetCode assets after 3 attempts."
          exit 1
